fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Assistant Statistical Officer ASO Mains Fee Payment 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a mains fee payment for the recruitment of Assistant Statistical Officer (ASO) posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment has been issued for 929 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Assistant Statistical Officer ASO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 21 April 2026, to 15 May 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSSSC Assistant Statistical Officer ASO Mains Fee Payment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 April 2026
  • Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 22 May 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 27 June 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
